description: Doações e comodatos - Selo Amigo de Minas Gerais is a dataset listed in State of Minas Gerais open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Geral do Estado de Minas Gerais. Em atenção à Lei nº 25.804, de 31 de março de 2026, que dispõe sobre a revisão geral do subsídio e do vencimento básico dos servidores públicos civis e militares da administração direta, autárquica e fundacional do Poder Executivo, destaca-se que a Secretaria-Geral, enquanto órgão responsável por apoiar o relacionamento institucional do governo em todos ... Coverage: Minas Gerais. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaria Geral do Estado de Minas Gerais. Its tags are doacao, governo, patrimônio. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Atribuição. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mg-portal.
